text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual sets up commission to prepare for referendum to amend the constitution this year. Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia heads the task-force.
- Former prime minister Mohamed Benahmed Abdelghani dies from heart attack.
- Zeroual invites opposition leaders to take part in a five-day conference to discuss social and economic strategy.
- State to pull out from the housing sector to make room for private business.
- France cuts 600 million FF from loans to Algeria.
- Opposition parties say Zeroual was not convincing in his news conference on Saturday.
